method: Theil–Sen flat-bottom baseline slopes and median caplines measured after four-times Lanczos sampling; fitted bounds are converted back to native pixel coordinates. One uniform scale per physical source page; independent row baselines; no individual glyph-height normalization.

regular-8-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

regular-8-census-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

byu-600-8-caps.method: Fifteen native stem-foot windows excluding U, both S forms, round overshoots and R tail; median column bottoms at T150, Theil-Sen slope and median intercept. Shape traces remain whole.
byu-600-8-caps.coordinate_convention: Native pixel rows occupy [y,y+1); anchors use last black pixel row plus one.
byu-600-8-caps.review: All fifteen native foot windows and full line overlay visually reviewed. Windows follow stem feet, avoiding rounded overshoots and R tail. Median baseline 2694, robust slope zero, maximum two-pixel residual at first P; no measurable common skew to correct.

broad_S_scale.method: One isotropic fit to eleven non-S capitals after independent fifteen-serif-foot row rotation. U, M and both S excluded.
